reviews.name: Telescope
reviews.reason: ACCEPT. V2 fixes the diorama failure completely: the exact pixels show one unmistakable freestanding refractor telescope with a dominant optical tube and front objective, coherent mount/focuser, grounded three-leg tripod/support geometry and a clean isolated silhouette. Berry-magenta treatment is restrained enough to preserve category identity, materials separate cleanly, and the telescope stays immediately readable at Store-card scale.

reviews.name: Mini Aquarium
reviews.reason: REWORK. The exact pixels read as a product-concept infographic with multiple aquarium vessels and UI/text-like annotation bars rather than one Mini Aquarium. The glass/water material treatment is promising and Galaxy Glow color is present, but category clarity and card-scale silhouette are weakened by duplicated tanks and overlay graphics. The smallest repair is one isolated compact rectangular aquarium with one base/lid/filter assembly, no second tank, no diagram callouts or text-like UI, and a simple uncluttered interior.
